Yes, that fallback is much better than blocking the save. When the automatic details couldn't be fetched, it told me so but still let me type my own title and description and save — the item now sits in my collection as "Private research notes" with "A page I still want to keep and revisit." and a plain neutral icon, and it still points at the address. So a page that won't give up its details automatically — like something behind a login — is still something I can keep, just with my own words. I'd much rather that than being told I can't save it at all.

I'm happy with that. What's next?
